params.prompt: In-game screenshot of a polished stylized 3D action-adventure game set in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul, Korea, inside a basement MMA gym. SCENE: afternoon, quiet. The camera stands on the lower steps of the entrance staircase coming down from the street: bare concrete steps with a dark green steel handrail, one bare fluorescent tube over the stairs, a steel shoe rack and a heap of rubber slippers at the bottom. Looking out over the whole room from slightly above: the blue puzzle mat area at the left with the mirror wall beyond it, the octagonal cage at center-right, the row of six heavy bags along the far right wall, the weight corner at the far left under the beams, and the lit office window at the far back. Two or three members train quietly: one shadow-boxes in the mirror, one stretches on the mat. The player character walks down the last steps, seen from behind. RENDERING STYLE: cel-shaded 3D that reads like a flat-colored anime background painting. Every surface is a flat color area with exactly one crisp shadow tone (a warm grey multiply of the base color, never black or muddy), thin warm-black ink outlines (#1A1417) on silhouettes, beams, frames and object edges; outlines get thinner with distance. No gradients on walls, no photographic textures, no realistic dirt: materials are suggested only by sparse hand-drawn marks (a few ink dots, short hatching strokes, mat seams). Muted low-saturation palette, subtle paper grain over the whole image, gentle split toning. SETTING: a basement MMA gym under a busy street in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul: one big low room about 20 by 13 meters with a 3.2 m ceiling of exposed raw grey concrete (#B9B6AF) with square concrete beams, two round grey ventilation ducts and a few conduit pipes; rows of cool-white twin-tube fluorescent light fixtures (#EAF0EC) hanging on short rods, their light slightly greenish; walls with a dark grey-green painted lower band (#4F5B55) about 1.2 m high and a cream upper wall (#E3D5B8); black rubber floor with pale speckles (#3A3A3A); a large area of interlocking puzzle mats in muted blue (#4A6B8A) with a cream border strip; one small black-steel octagonal cage about 6 m across with dark-red padded posts (#7A3A32), black chain-link mesh fence and an off-white canvas floor (#E8E2D6) raised one step; six heavy bags, black and dark red, hanging from a steel rail under a ceiling beam along one wall; a small weight corner with a barbell rack, dumbbell rack, flat bench, kettlebells, a tractor tire and a coiled battle rope; a small office in the corner with a big clear-glass window in an aluminium frame, inside a desk, an office chair, a steel cabinet, a champion belt mounted on a plain wooden plaque and one framed old fight poster that is only a picture with no text; a mirror wall; a row of grey steel lockers; a stand fan, a water dispenser, a wall round-timer box, a whiteboard on a stand, a steel shoe rack with a heap of rubber slippers, blank solid-color posters on the walls. Shapes are clean and readable like a real-time 3D game built from modular pieces, yet rich in props. CAMERA: third-person over-the-shoulder game camera, lens height about 1.7 m, 35 mm lens, natural eye-level perspective. The reference image shows the player character: draw him small, seen from behind, standing at the lower left third and filling about one third of the image height; in the gym he wears a plain dark grey t-shirt and black shorts, barefoot. No HUD, no UI, no watermark. All posters, boards, banners and the belt plaque are blank solid color panels with at most simple abstract shapes: absolutely no letters, no Korean or English text, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks anywhere. No alcohol, no cigarettes.
